# Graph-Guided Retrieval for Scientific Agents

## Abstract

We study scientific agents that combine full-text evidence, graph retrieval, and adaptive navigation.

## Introduction

Scientific workflows need provenance-preserving retrieval over paper text. A stable article loader should keep the original source path, source type, media type, checksum, parser metadata, and warnings.

## Method

The loader reads deterministic local artifacts before any network acquisition, graph import, or embedding generation is attempted.

## Conclusion

Local article loading provides a reliable contract for downstream evidence bundle paths.
